tools.name: ask_hirepulse_advisor
tools.description: Free advisor that maps B2B leads, hiring signals, buying intent, tech stack, Google Ads and due diligence goals to a tool, price, free-call balance and ready-to-run request preview. For unclear tool choice or cost; get_company_profile provides a full brief for a known domain. Includes four n8n recip

tools.name: detect_website_tech_stack
tools.description: Website tech stack for a company domain: ad pixels (Meta, Google Ads, LinkedIn, TikTok), analytics, tag managers, CMS, e-commerce, hosting and payments, plus email provider, SPF and DMARC from DNS. $0.005 per result after 5 free calls a day; blocked or empty sites are free. Use for technology-only r

tools.name: get_company_open_jobs
tools.description: Live jobs from public Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, Recruitee or SmartRecruiters boards: titles, departments, locations, remote flag and published salary. Up to 300 jobs; known_job_ids gives new/closed jobs. $0.01; no board/jobs is free. Role listings; get_company_hiring_intent gives a score,

tools.name: get_company_hiring_intent
tools.description: Hiring-based intent score (0-100), status, open roles, postings from the last 30 days, functions and technologies from a public job board. A heuristic, not confirmed purchase intent. $0.01; no board/jobs is free. For company prioritization; get_company_open_jobs gives listings, get_company_profile c

tools.name: get_google_ads_by_domain
tools.description: Public Google Ads Transparency Center evidence: advertiser status, estimated ad count and up to 40 ads with format, dates and links. Optional region filter. $0.01; no ads is free. For competitor advertising research; no private account access. get_company_profile combines ads with other company sign

tools.name: get_company_profile
tools.description: Company profile: tech stack, hiring intent, Google Ads, published contacts (emails, social links, MX) and breakout_summary growth estimates. $0.03 only when at least 2 of 4 sections have data; one of 5 free daily calls. Growth estimates are not forecasts. Single-signal tools narrow research; batch_l

tools.name: extract_company_contacts
tools.description: Published contacts for a company domain from its home, about, contact, team and careers pages: deduplicated emails and LinkedIn, X and GitHub links, plus MX, SPF and DMARC checks (not mailbox verification). $0.01; nothing found is free.

tools.name: claim_free_trial
tools.description: One-time pass: 25 successful calls shared across supported single-domain tools, valid 30 days and independent of IP. Excludes private lookup, quote redemption and paid email inboxes. Send one active Base wallet or work email (no email sent). Use X-Trial-Token or MCP metadata hirepulse/trial_token.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?profile=b2b&ref=registry-b2b" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_company_profile · Private data: detect_website_tech_stack, get_google_ads_by_domain, get_company_profile, extract_company_contacts, claim_free_trial · Public sink: detect_website_tech_stack, claim_free_trial · Destructive: ask_hirepulse_advisor, get_google_ads_by_domain.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_company_profile · Private data: detect_website_tech_stack, get_google_ads_by_domain, get_company_profile, extract_company_contacts, claim_free_trial · Public sink: detect_website_tech_stack, claim_free_trial · Destructive: ask_hirepulse_advisor, get_google_ads_by_domain

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "ask_hirepulse_advisor" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
